name: Koregaon Park
summary: A leafy, mainly residential neighbourhood close to central Pune, known for its dining and nightlife and increasingly for commercial use.
knownFor: Restaurants, nightlife, art galleries and music venues
connectivity: North Main Road and South Main Road are the main roads
Bund Garden bridge links to Yerawada; Aga Khan Bridge links to Kalyani Nagar
About 3.8 km from Pune Junction railway station
suits: Households wanting a central, leafy neighbourhood close to restaurants and the city centre.
